anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow convex arc with a large radius forming a low-profile forehead region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with a high thickness-to-length ratio visible at the anterior terminus.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle (approximately 145 degrees) at the pixel intersection of the melon and the dorsal rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Monochromatic cyan-green luminescence and semi-translucent surface rendering across the entire organism silhouette.
